method: Read each of the 74 previously flagged record claims alongside its proposed target and source observation/action identifiers. Preserve separate towns, temporal moments, countries, and Mass cue identities. Absorb only redundant or supporting details into the lead draft; topic comparison does not count as a duplicate. Source images, French proofreading and final approval remain pending.

meanings.ABSORB_SUPPORTING_DETAIL: Supporting or already subsumed point; retain original observation, enrich lead if source-confirmed; not independently publishable yet.
meanings.HOME_PREVIEW_SAME_SOURCE_VARIANT: Same glossary record as Home preview but not necessarily identical; check whether concise value lies in rewriting existing preview.
meanings.RETAIN_DISTINCT_INCORRECT_LEAD: Previous proposed merge target is wrong or unrelated; restore as independent candidate or reserve, without inventing another merge.
meanings.COMPARE_RELATED_VARIANTS: Related by feast or custom but still independent local action or geography; optionally create transparent comparison with separate source citations.
meanings.HOLD_HISTORICAL_PRECISION: Original historical interpretation needs a narrower witness and qualification, not an automatic release.

own_original_claim.fr: Dans certains foyers, on priait et chantait devant la crèche la veille de Noël avant d'ouvrir les cadeaux.

lead_original_claim.en: In some Christmas households, the Gospel, a prayer at the crib and a hymn preceded gifts attributed to the Christ Child.
lead_original_claim.fr: Dans certains foyers, l'Évangile, une prière à la crèche et un cantique précédaient les présents attribués à l'Enfant Jésus.

decisions.factual_rationale: Evergreen candle pyramids differ from three-light arrangements symbolizing the Trinity.

own_original_claim.en: German Christmas decorations once included candle pyramids built with evergreen branches.
own_original_claim.fr: Les décorations allemandes de Noël comprenaient autrefois des pyramides de bougies ornées de branches persistantes.

lead_original_claim.en: Some older Christmas candle arrangements joined three lights to symbolize the Holy Trinity.
lead_original_claim.fr: Certains anciens arrangements de bougies de Noël réunissaient trois flammes pour symboliser la Sainte Trinité.

decisions.factual_rationale: German Christstollen is not Ukrainian wheat-and-honey kutia.

own_original_claim.en: The Christstollen belongs to an older regional tradition of German Christmas breads.
own_original_claim.fr: Le Christstollen s'inscrit dans une ancienne tradition régionale de pains de Noël allemands.

lead_original_claim.en: Ukrainian Christmas Eve meals traditionally included kutia, prepared from wheat, honey and poppy seeds.
lead_original_claim.fr: Les repas ukrainiens de la veille de Noël comprenaient traditionnellement la koutia, à base de blé, de miel et de pavot.

decisions.factual_rationale: Spanish or Latin American pastries are not Ukrainian kutia.

own_original_claim.en: Christmas sweets recorded in Spain and Latin America included almond pastries and buñuelos.
own_original_claim.fr: Parmi les douceurs de Noël recensées en Espagne et en Amérique latine figuraient les pâtisseries aux amandes et les buñuelos.

lead_original_claim.en: Ukrainian Christmas Eve meals traditionally included kutia, prepared from wheat, honey and poppy seeds.
lead_original_claim.fr: Les repas ukrainiens de la veille de Noël comprenaient traditionnellement la koutia, à base de blé, de miel et de pavot.

decisions.factual_rationale: French-Canadian beignes and sucre à la crème are not Ukrainian kutia.

own_original_claim.en: French-Canadian Christmas food traditions included beignes and sucre à la crème.
own_original_claim.fr: Les traditions culinaires de Noël des Canadiens français comprenaient les beignes et le sucre à la crème.

lead_original_claim.en: Ukrainian Christmas Eve meals traditionally included kutia, prepared from wheat, honey and poppy seeds.
lead_original_claim.fr: Les repas ukrainiens de la veille de Noël comprenaient traditionnellement la koutia, à base de blé, de miel et de pavot.

decisions.factual_rationale: The Paris straw-effigy Alleluia farewell contrasts with Toul's ceremonial burial, and their local forms should remain distinguishable.

own_original_claim.en: In Paris, an old farewell to the Alleluia could use a straw effigy rather than an actual liturgical burial.
own_original_claim.fr: À Paris, un ancien adieu à l'Alléluia pouvait employer une effigie de paille plutôt qu'un véritable enterrement liturgique.

lead_original_claim.en: Choirboys in Toul once enacted a symbolic burial of the Alleluia before the pre-Lenten season.
lead_original_claim.fr: À Toul, des enfants de chœur mettaient autrefois en scène un enterrement symbolique de l'Alléluia avant le Carême.

decisions.factual_rationale: Easter eggs distributed as gifts differ from butter/sugar lamb-shaped foods.

own_original_claim.en: Decorated Easter eggs were historically presented to children and household workers as gifts.
own_original_claim.fr: Les œufs de Pâques décorés étaient autrefois offerts aux enfants et aux employés de maison.

lead_original_claim.en: Easter lambs were fashioned not only from pastry but sometimes from butter or sugar for the family table.
lead_original_claim.fr: On façonnait des agneaux de Pâques non seulement en pâtisserie, mais aussi parfois en beurre ou en sucre pour la table familiale.

decisions.factual_rationale: Easter egg hunts and games differ from a single blessed egg shared at family breakfast.

own_original_claim.en: Easter egg hunts and games belonged to family tradition rather than to the Church's official rites.
own_original_claim.fr: La chasse aux œufs et les jeux de Pâques relevaient des traditions familiales, non des rites officiels de l'Église.

lead_original_claim.en: Some Slavic families divided a single blessed Easter egg among everyone at breakfast.
lead_original_claim.fr: Dans certaines familles slaves, on partageait un seul œuf pascal béni entre tous les convives au petit déjeuner.

decisions.factual_rationale: A decorated paska loaf differs from lambs formed of butter or sugar.

own_original_claim.en: Some traditional paska Easter loaves carried a cross on their crust.
own_original_claim.fr: Certains pains traditionnels de Pâques appelés paska portaient une croix sur leur croûte.

lead_original_claim.en: Easter lambs were fashioned not only from pastry but sometimes from butter or sugar for the family table.
lead_original_claim.fr: On façonnait des agneaux de Pâques non seulement en pâtisserie, mais aussi parfois en beurre ou en sucre pour la table familiale.

decisions.factual_rationale: Austrian Easter loaves are not an Easter lamb moulded in butter or sugar.

own_original_claim.en: Austrian Easter loaves and Osterstollen formed distinct regional types of festive bread.
own_original_claim.fr: Les pains de Pâques autrichiens et l'Osterstollen représentaient des variantes régionales de pains de fête.

lead_original_claim.en: Easter lambs were fashioned not only from pastry but sometimes from butter or sugar for the family table.
lead_original_claim.fr: On façonnait des agneaux de Pâques non seulement en pâtisserie, mais aussi parfois en beurre ou en sucre pour la table familiale.

decisions.factual_rationale: Polish mazurki are a separate Easter cake, not a butter or sugar Easter lamb.

own_original_claim.en: Polish mazurki were among the regional cakes served at Easter.
own_original_claim.fr: Les mazurki polonais figuraient parmi les gâteaux régionaux servis à Pâques.

lead_original_claim.en: Easter lambs were fashioned not only from pastry but sometimes from butter or sugar for the family table.
lead_original_claim.fr: On façonnait des agneaux de Pâques non seulement en pâtisserie, mais aussi parfois en beurre ou en sucre pour la table familiale.

decisions.factual_rationale: Birch greenery and sacred-image windows are different but complementary decorations along Corpus Christi routes.

own_original_claim.en: Birch branches once decorated houses and streets along Corpus Christi processions in some regions.
own_original_claim.fr: Des branches de bouleau décoraient autrefois les maisons et rues sur le parcours de processions de la Fête-Dieu.

lead_original_claim.en: Windows along Corpus Christi procession routes were sometimes adorned with candles and sacred images.
lead_original_claim.fr: Les fenêtres longeant les processions de la Fête-Dieu étaient parfois ornées de cierges et d'images saintes.

decisions.factual_rationale: Flower wreaths decorating procession structures differ from Polish blessed wreaths later displayed by houses or fields.

own_original_claim.en: Flower wreaths could decorate Corpus Christi banners, houses and poles, apart from the Eucharistic rite itself.
own_original_claim.fr: Des couronnes de fleurs pouvaient orner bannières, maisons et perches pour la Fête-Dieu, indépendamment du rite eucharistique.

lead_original_claim.en: In some Polish places, blessed Corpus Christi wreaths were later hung in houses or near fields.
lead_original_claim.fr: En certains lieux de Pologne, les couronnes bénies à la Fête-Dieu étaient ensuite suspendues dans les maisons ou près des champs.

decisions.factual_rationale: Early Christian martyr-tomb observance and German Kirchweih dedication festivals are different eras and practices.

own_original_claim.en: Early Christians commemorated martyrs by visiting their tombs, especially on their death anniversaries.
own_original_claim.fr: Les premiers chrétiens commémoraient les martyrs en visitant leurs tombeaux, notamment au jour anniversaire de leur mort.

lead_original_claim.en: German Kirchweih or Kirmes festivities historically combined a church's dedication or patronal feast with local celebrations.
lead_original_claim.fr: Les Kirchweih ou Kirmes allemandes associaient autrefois la dédicace ou la fête patronale d'une église à des réjouissances locales.

decisions.factual_rationale: Blessing countryside and fields is different from Portuguese boats or sea blessings at Assumption.

own_original_claim.en: Some local Assumption celebrations included blessings of fields and countryside.
own_original_claim.fr: Certaines célébrations locales de l'Assomption comportaient des bénédictions des champs et de la campagne.

lead_original_claim.en: Some Portuguese coastal communities included boats or the sea in local Assumption blessings.
lead_original_claim.fr: Certaines communautés côtières portugaises associaient barques ou mer aux bénédictions locales de l'Assomption.

decisions.factual_rationale: Blessing Alpine livestock is distinct from Portuguese coastal blessings at Assumption.

own_original_claim.en: In Alpine areas, blessings of mountain livestock could be associated with Assumption celebrations.
own_original_claim.fr: Dans les régions alpines, des bénédictions du bétail de montagne pouvaient accompagner les fêtes de l'Assomption.

lead_original_claim.en: Some Portuguese coastal communities included boats or the sea in local Assumption blessings.
lead_original_claim.fr: Certaines communautés côtières portugaises associaient barques ou mer aux bénédictions locales de l'Assomption.

decisions.factual_rationale: Graveside lights at All Souls differ in location and purpose from a Candlemas-blessed household candle.

own_original_claim.en: Lanterns and protected candles were placed at graves around All Saints and All Souls in some countries.
own_original_claim.fr: Dans certains pays, on déposait des lanternes et des cierges protégés sur les tombes à la Toussaint et au jour des Défunts.

lead_original_claim.en: Some families preserved a blessed Candlemas candle and lit it when praying for the dead at All Souls.
lead_original_claim.fr: Certaines familles conservaient un cierge béni à la Chandeleur et l'allumaient pour prier pour les défunts.

decisions.factual_rationale: Brazilian visits and candles at cemeteries are different regional evidence from Philippine grave repairs for the novena.

own_original_claim.en: Brazilian All Souls observances historically included cemetery visits, prayers and candles.
own_original_claim.fr: Au Brésil, les anciennes pratiques du jour des Défunts comprenaient visites au cimetière, prières et cierges.

lead_original_claim.en: In the Philippines, families repaired graves in preparation for an All Souls novena.
lead_original_claim.fr: Aux Philippines, des familles entretenaient les tombes en vue d'une neuvaine pour les défunts.

decisions.factual_rationale: Tuesday Saint Anthony novenas are not the Basque sailors' mast-mounted Saint Anthony shrines.

own_original_claim.en: Tuesday devotions and continuing novenas to Saint Anthony appear in historical Catholic practice.
own_original_claim.fr: Des dévotions du mardi et des neuvaines permanentes à saint Antoine sont attestées dans l'histoire catholique.

lead_original_claim.en: Some Basque sailors historically kept a small shrine to Saint Anthony on a ship's mast.
lead_original_claim.fr: Certains marins basques installaient autrefois un petit sanctuaire dédié à saint Antoine sur le mât de leur bateau.

decisions.factual_rationale: Ways pilgrims travelled to Altavilla are distinct from its tall decorated votive candles.

own_original_claim.en: Pilgrims reached the Loreto shrine at Altavilla by several routes, including on foot, by carriage, rail and boat.
own_original_claim.fr: Les pèlerins rejoignaient le sanctuaire de Notre-Dame de Lorette à Altavilla à pied, en voiture, en train ou en bateau.

lead_original_claim.en: Some Altavilla pilgrims carried long decorated votive candles as tall as their own bodies.
lead_original_claim.fr: Certains pèlerins d'Altavilla portaient de longs cierges votifs décorés, parfois aussi hauts qu'eux.

decisions.factual_rationale: Drumming to summon candle-bearers supplies a striking additional detail to Saint Conrad's lit candle procession in Noto.

own_original_claim.en: In Noto, a drummer once summoned participants bringing tall devotional candles to Saint Conrad's procession.
own_original_claim.fr: À Noto, un tambour rappelait autrefois les participants portant de grands cierges votifs à la procession de saint Conrad.

lead_original_claim.en: At Noto, Saint Conrad's reliquary passed between rows of lighted votive structures while devotees knelt.
lead_original_claim.fr: À Noto, le reliquaire de saint Conrad passait entre des rangées de structures votives allumées tandis que les fidèles s'agenouillaient.

decisions.factual_rationale: White garments and headscarves characterize Saint Conrad participants; retain alongside the procession's votive lights.

own_original_claim.en: Some devotees joining Saint Conrad's Noto procession wore long white garments and white headscarves.
own_original_claim.fr: Certains fidèles de la procession de saint Conrad à Noto portaient de longues tenues blanches et un foulard blanc.

lead_original_claim.en: At Noto, Saint Conrad's reliquary passed between rows of lighted votive structures while devotees knelt.
lead_original_claim.fr: À Noto, le reliquaire de saint Conrad passait entre des rangées de structures votives allumées tandis que les fidèles s'agenouillaient.

decisions.factual_rationale: Children bringing a crown, mantle and halo differ from the machinery raising the Madonna image at Villafranca; no sequence inferred.

own_original_claim.en: At Villafranca, festively dressed children brought offerings such as a mantle, crown and halo to the Madonna.
own_original_claim.fr: À Villafranca, des enfants en habits de fête apportaient à la Vierge des offrandes comme un manteau, une couronne et une auréole.

lead_original_claim.en: During old Villafranca Vespers, a pulley mechanism raised the Madonna delle Mortelle image behind the altar.
lead_original_claim.fr: Pendant les anciennes vêpres de Villafranca, une poulie soulevait l'image de la Madonna delle Mortelle derrière l'autel.

decisions.factual_rationale: The winner paying to illuminate a Racalmuto candle structure enriches the existing description of those structures.

own_original_claim.en: At Racalmuto, the winner of a festival competition had to illuminate a large devotional candle structure at personal expense.
own_original_claim.fr: À Racalmuto, le gagnant d'un concours de fête devait illuminer à ses frais une grande structure votive à cierges.

lead_original_claim.en: Large candle-bearing structures called cilii appeared in old Racalmuto Marian processions.
lead_original_claim.fr: De grandes structures à cierges appelées cilii figuraient dans les anciennes processions mariales de Racalmuto.

decisions.factual_rationale: Three-day Sambuca feast and evening schedule can qualify the dramatic candlelight procession description.

own_original_claim.en: Sambuca's Madonna dell'Udienza festival once unfolded over three days, with an evening procession.
own_original_claim.fr: À Sambuca, la fête de la Madonna dell'Udienza s'étendait autrefois sur trois jours et comprenait une procession du soir.

lead_original_claim.en: The lights carried by pilgrims in Sambuca's historical Marian procession were compared to a river of fire.
lead_original_claim.fr: Les lumières portées par les pèlerins de l'ancienne procession mariale de Sambuca étaient comparées à un fleuve de feu.

decisions.factual_rationale: The Te igitur and Quam oblationem three-cross gestures happen at different points of the Canon; never merge their cue IDs.

own_original_claim.en: During Te igitur, the celebrant traces three crosses over the Host and chalice together.
own_original_claim.fr: Pendant le Te igitur, le célébrant trace trois croix au-dessus de l'hostie et du calice ensemble.

lead_original_claim.en: At benedictam, adscriptam and ratam in Quam oblationem, the priest traces three crosses over both offerings.
lead_original_claim.fr: Aux mots benedictam, adscriptam et ratam du Quam oblationem, le prêtre trace trois croix au-dessus des deux oblats.

decisions.factual_rationale: Chalice-only Sanguis cross is already paired with Host-only Corpus cross in the updated Quam oblationem featured copy.

own_original_claim.en: The cross at Sanguis in Quam oblationem is traced over the chalice alone.
own_original_claim.fr: La croix au mot Sanguis dans le Quam oblationem est tracée au-dessus du calice seul.

lead_original_claim.en: The cross traced at Corpus in Quam oblationem is made over the Host alone.
lead_original_claim.fr: La croix tracée au mot Corpus dans le Quam oblationem est faite au-dessus de l'hostie seule.

decisions.factual_rationale: Quiet Host Consecration is a different point from the non-breaking meaning of fregit in the preceding narrative.

own_original_claim.en: The words of consecration over the Host are pronounced quietly, before the public elevation.
own_original_claim.fr: Les paroles de la consécration de l'hostie sont prononcées à voix basse, avant l'élévation visible des fidèles.

lead_original_claim.en: The word fregit in the consecration narrative does not mean that the Host is broken at that moment.
lead_original_claim.fr: Le mot fregit dans le récit de l'institution ne signifie pas que l'hostie est rompue à cet instant.

decisions.factual_rationale: Quiet chalice Consecration is not the moment described by Host narrative fregit.

own_original_claim.en: The words of consecration over the chalice are pronounced quietly while the priest bends over it.
own_original_claim.fr: Les paroles de consécration du calice sont prononcées à voix basse tandis que le prêtre s'incline au-dessus de lui.

lead_original_claim.en: The word fregit in the consecration narrative does not mean that the Host is broken at that moment.
lead_original_claim.fr: Le mot fregit dans le récit de l'institution ne signifie pas que l'hostie est rompue à cet instant.

decisions.factual_rationale: Unde et memores is after Consecration; its three crosses are different from those in Quam oblationem before Consecration.

own_original_claim.en: During Unde et memores, the priest traces three crosses over the consecrated Host and chalice together.
own_original_claim.fr: Pendant l'Unde et memores, le prêtre trace trois croix sur l'hostie et le calice consacrés ensemble.

lead_original_claim.en: At benedictam, adscriptam and ratam in Quam oblationem, the priest traces three crosses over both offerings.
lead_original_claim.fr: Aux mots benedictam, adscriptam et ratam du Quam oblationem, le prêtre trace trois croix au-dessus des deux oblats.

decisions.factual_rationale: Memento of the dead and Memento of the living are categorically distinct prayers, on different sides of Consecration.

own_original_claim.en: A short silent remembrance of the departed belongs to the Roman Canon's prayers after consecration.
own_original_claim.fr: Un bref souvenir silencieux des défunts fait partie des prières du Canon romain après la consécration.

lead_original_claim.en: The Memento of the living includes an interval in which the priest commemorates particular people quietly.
lead_original_claim.fr: Le Memento des vivants comprend un moment où le prêtre fait mémoire de personnes particulières en silence.

decisions.factual_rationale: Three Host crosses at Per ipsum differ from the subsequent small elevation, though both occur in the closing doxology.

own_original_claim.en: At Per ipsum, cum ipso and in ipso, the priest traces three crosses with the consecrated Host above the chalice.
own_original_claim.fr: Aux mots Per ipsum, cum ipso et in ipso, le prêtre trace trois croix avec l'hostie consacrée au-dessus du calice.

lead_original_claim.en: The small elevation at the close of the Canon is different from the greater elevations after each consecration.
lead_original_claim.fr: La petite élévation à la fin du Canon est distincte des grandes élévations qui suivent chacune des consécrations.

decisions.factual_rationale: Two crosses at Patri and Sancti differ from the small elevation; do not flatten into one movement.

own_original_claim.en: At Patri and Sancti in the final doxology, two crosses with the Host are made between the chalice and the priest's breast.
own_original_claim.fr: Aux mots Patri et Sancti de la doxologie finale, deux croix sont tracées avec l'hostie entre le calice et la poitrine du prêtre.

lead_original_claim.en: The small elevation at the close of the Canon is different from the greater elevations after each consecration.
lead_original_claim.fr: La petite élévation à la fin du Canon est distincte des grandes élévations qui suivent chacune des consécrations.
